tasks.text: Resolve the public-page and checkout pricing discrepancy. Keep this campaign on hold until verified.

assets.title: For the owner doing the office work
assets.body:
After class, there's still tuition to check and a student who hasn't been back in two weeks.

DojoZeus keeps attendance, tuition, waivers, and your school's website together. Zeus reads the school records and helps you work through the office tasks.

If you run a martial arts school, take a look at the tour:

assets.title: Start with the absent students
assets.body:
The first screen I'd show a school owner is the list of students who have stopped coming. That's someone to check on before another month passes.

DojoZeus brings attendance and school records together so you can see who needs a follow-up. Here's the product tour:

campaigns.followup: For an owner who has replied: Which takes more of your time right now, tracking tuition or following up with students? I can show you that part of DojoZeus first.

assets.title: Start with one lesson you already teach
assets.body:
If you teach a workshop, you already have somewhere to start an online school. Put one lesson on Lyceum and see how it feels from the student's side.

Your students get the lesson, a place to ask questions, and a tutor that answers from your material. You keep your domain, member list, and Stripe account.

You can build free before choosing a paid plan:

assets.title: See a school before building yours
assets.body:
Lyceum has a working ceramics school you can look through before signing up. See the classroom and how lessons are organized, then think about the course you already teach.

The example school is linked from the homepage. You can build your own studio free:

assets.title: Follow up on the estimate
assets.body:
A customer declined the repair. The finding is still on the ticket, and someone needs to follow up.

Mech Correct keeps inspection photos, estimates, and customer messages with the job. You can see the work that was declined and follow up from the shop record.

Try the workflow with your next job:

assets.body:
